name: Ironveil Disgraced CorpSec Bouncer's Door Rig
description: A stripped Brightline corporate security jacket with all insignia cut off — the ghost outlines of rank patches still visible as darker rectangles on the sleeve. Underneath, a plain black compression mock-neck that hides a spinal augmentation rig up to C4. Tactical trousers with the knee-armor pockets emptied out and re-stuffed with a flask and a burner comm. One boot is standard-issue military; the other is a mismatched Shelf replacement.
functionality: Residual ballistic-weave in jacket provides light protection; spinal rig channel remains fully functional under the mock-neck.
what_it_says: Someone who used to have authority and now enforces someone else's door for Φ12 an hour.
story_hooks: The rank patch outlines are from a Brightline division that was publicly dissolved after a massacre — anyone who knows CorpSec history will recognize it.
The emptied knee-armor pockets once held classified hardware that this person quietly kept and hid elsewhere.
